sourceGaps.auditBasis: The owner selected the whole series from its first issue. The metadata service lists Marvel Action Avengers (2018) #1-4 and #6-12 in series 29501, two narrow searches return no #5, and the one unlisted id between #4 (83422) and #6 (83424) answers 404, which is not evidence that it is #5. Preserve this position and do not infer nonpublication or reading availability.
